vocab.definition: forward and backward rates are equal (closed system).
a system shifts to oppose any change made to it.
whether more products or reactants are present.
the amount of product at equilibrium.

misconceptions.wrong: At equilibrium the reaction has stopped.
misconceptions.right: Both reactions continue at equal rates.
It means equal RATES, not equal amounts.
A catalyst speeds up both sides equally — no shift.

infoPanels.title: LE CHATELIER'S PRINCIPLE
workedSteps: Increase concentration of a reactant → shifts right.
!Increase pressure → shifts to the side with fewer gas moles.
Increase temperature → shifts in the endothermic direction.
!The system acts to oppose the change.
A catalyst does NOT change the position.
